Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to learn that you are disappointed with the temperature of your new grill. It is normal for new grills to run hotter than usual, and this should change over time.

It is normal to expect the lowest temperature of your grill to be about 325 degrees. If you are interested in cooking at lower temperatures than that, a dedicated smoker will give you the results you desire.

We'd like to help you get the most from your grill. Please look for an email outreach from our Support team soon. Thank  you!

Results.ReviewText: I bought my first Weber Kettle in 1976. Over the years I've replaced my gassers as newer models with more feature rich choices became available. Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I had a basic gas grill that I bought at a retail store many years ago. It worked well, but definitely had hot spots, and eventually the thin metal rusted through, causing one of the burners to fall out of place.

I decided to replace that grill with something of higher quality. Right out of the box, even before assembly, I could tell this Weber grill was like a luxury item compared to my last grill. Even the packages was very well done.

The grill itself is sturdy, and the metal is much thicker, meaning it will hold up much longer. The thicker grates are much nicer than what I've had previously, and the ignitor works very well. So far with the few times I've used it, heating has been even throughout the grilling surface. I also love the fact that this grill has a scale to give you an idea of how much gas is left in the propane tank.

So even though this cost about 3 times more than the previous grill I bought, I'm very satisfied with my purchase. It's a quality product and I wouldn't hesitate to buy it again.
Results.Title: Best grill I've ever owned

Results.ReviewText:
We have always enjoyed using our Weber gas grill and also taken good care of it, performing all recommended maintenance, keeping it meticulously clean, not keeping it out in the elements and not abusing it.

Unfortunately, we’ve had issues with the Electronic Ignition System—it was completely broken—the rubber covering on the button deteriorated and the button didn’t work anymore. We called the warranty department and requested a brand new igniter kit and, burner tube kit. As both of these items were completely broken as well. We believe that the failure of these parts were not due to neglect or error on our part. The Weber company covered in full the replacement of the ignition part. Paint was peeling off the top too, but, we were told that is normal wear and tear.

Now my husband fixed our gas grill so we’re back in business grilling just in time for the good weather spring/summer. Thanks very much, Weber!
Results.Title: Very pleased with our Spirit II

Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach.
